column1: # Plugins managed by plugins.sh. TAB-separated, use "-" for an empty field:
#   name  tool  kind  check  install  update
# tool:  CLI that must be on PATH ("-" = none needed)
#        remote = pipes a remote script into a shell, always needs an explicit yes
#        manual = install field is instructions only, plugins.sh just prints it
# check: shell command, exit 0 = already installed
# Add a row to roll a new plugin out to every machine on its next ./plugins.sh run.

column5: claude plugin marketplace add DietrichGebert/ponytail; claude plugin install ponytail@ponytail
column6: claude plugin marketplace update ponytail && claude plugin update ponytail@ponytail
